title: Conway's Game of Life
prompt:
Read from standard input: a first line `W H G`, then H lines of W characters (`#` is a live cell, `.` a dead one). Run G generations of Conway's Game of Life on this grid, which is bounded: cells outside the grid are always dead. In each generation, all cells change at the same time: a live cell with two or three live neighbours (among the eight around it) stays alive, any other live cell dies, and a dead cell with exactly three live neighbours becomes alive.

Print the grid after G generations as H lines of W characters in the same notation, then a line `alive=N` with the number of live cells. With G = 0 the grid is printed unchanged.
